# Nestbolt

> Free, open-source (MIT) nesting of parts on fixed sheets for laser, CNC, plasma, waterjet, fabric and leather cutting. Native CLI, stdio MCP server and an in-browser WebAssembly app share one Rust engine. v0.1.0 was released on 2026-10-14. The v1.1 real-shop-file plan is in progress; see Status for completed gates and remaining work.

- [README](README.md): what works, quick start, browser build and development commands.
- [Guides and examples](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/llms.txt): the site's own llms.txt, linking the browser app, the comparison with Deepnest and SVGnest, and the five example jobs.
- [Agent interface](docs/AGENT_INTERFACE.md): MCP tools, request format, workspace rules and how to connect Claude Code, Codex or Claude Desktop.
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/skulitom/Nestbolt/blob/main/plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json): `/plugin marketplace add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skulitom/Nestbolt/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, then `/plugin install nestbolt@nestbolt` (only the plugin folder is fetched). It starts nestbolt-mcp from PATH, from the v0.1.0 release archive (which predates quick_start), and adds the nestbolt skill.
- [Search contract](docs/SEARCH_CONTRACT.md): time and work budgets, seeds, repeatability and what a result guarantees.
- [Importing](docs/IMPORTING.md): units, cutting layers and colours, optional repairs and import messages.
- [LightBurn projects](docs/LBRN2.md): editable per-sheet exports, fixed shapes and required text/group preparation.
- [Lead-in allowances](docs/LEAD_INS.md): reserved space, contour starts and separate review paths.
- [Common-line cutting](docs/COMMON_LINES.md): kerf compensation, CAM preparation and material-use limitations.
- [Schemas](schemas/README.md): JSON Schemas for the part library, nest request, nest report and the independent validator's job, layout and report.
- [Status](docs/STATUS.md): completed milestones, evidence and remaining work.
- [v1 plan](docs/PLAN.md): original scope, acceptance gates G1–G8 and ground rules.
- [v1.1 plan](docs/PLAN_V1_1.md): real shop files, LightBurn preservation, browser curves and cutting allowances, with gates H1–H6.
- [Benchmarks](BENCHMARKS.md): append-only log of every run, including failures.
- [Licences](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES): dependency inventory; jagua-rs (MPL-2.0) is unmodified and the separator is adapted from Sparrow (MIT).

The MCP server `nestbolt-mcp` has five tools: import_parts, nest, validate_layout, export_layout and estimate_sheets.
All paths must be inside its workspace (working directory or NESTBOLT_WORKSPACE); it never overwrites files.
`nest` budgets (time_budget_s, at most 300) are deterministic work: the same inputs, budget and seed repeat the layout unless the reply says "repeatable": false.
Optional request field `quick_start: true` tries a conservative initial arrangement before improving it; it defaults to false and may change material use. Keep this setting when replaying a job.
Every returned layout has passed the independent Clipper2 validator. Exports keep the original arcs and curves.
estimate_sheets is a lower bound, not a layout. No files are uploaded anywhere. Nestbolt gives no machine-safety or fit certification.

## Optional

- [Anode](https://github.com/skulitom/Anode): sibling tool (same author, MIT, local MCP server): a hidden background Windows desktop for agents' GUI automation, screenshots and app testing.
- [Pixelbolt](https://github.com/skulitom/Pixelbolt): sibling tool (same author, MIT, local MCP server): pixel art and sprite animation from editable JSON recipes.
- [Cutbolt](https://github.com/skulitom/Cutbolt): sibling tool (same author, MIT, local MCP server): video editing engine with exact timelines, captions and rendering.
- [Inkbolt](https://github.com/skulitom/Inkbolt): sibling tool (same author, MIT, local MCP server): vector and raster image editing for diagrams; SVG in, SVG and PDF out.
